reuse.why: Takes its categories from the existing getFillableCategories, but computes last month's spending with its own SQL over v_transactions_internal_alive instead of the sheet's sum-amount-<category> cells that getCategoryAverage already reads via getSheetValue.

duplication.why: Copies the per-action income/tracking check and the expense sign flip, and re-derives category spending that the budget sheet already holds.

placement.why: Action sits in budget/actions.ts and is registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like its siblings; the raw transaction aggregation with a hand-built day 1-31 range is lower-level than the rest of the actions.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and a release note.

maintainability.why: A second source of truth for monthly spending (SQL vs sheet) can drift from what the budget shows, e.g. on off-budget or transfer handling.

bypasses_abstraction.where: setLastMonthSpending aggregates transactions in SQL instead of reading the sheet's sum-amount-<category> value used by getCategoryAverage.

disguised_duplication.where: The monthly category spending the sheet computes is re-derived as a reshaped SQL SUM grouped by category; the income check and sign flip are copied in a reshaped `cat.is_income === 1 ? sum : -sum || 0` form.
